description: This file defines custom exception classes for the Orleans.Serialization namespace, including a base SerializerException and various specific exceptions related to serialization errors, such as schema issues, type mismatches, and reference errors.

classes.name: SerializerException
classes.description: Base exception class for serialization errors, inheriting from System.Exception, with multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios.

classes.name: FieldIdNotPresentException
classes.description: Indicates that a field identifier was expected but not present during deserialization.

classes.name: SchemaTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Indicates that the schema type encountered is invalid.

classes.name: FieldTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Indicates that a field type is invalid.

classes.name: FieldTypeMissingException
classes.description: Indicates that a field type was expected but not found.

classes.name: ExtendedWireTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Indicates that the extended wire type is invalid.

classes.name: UnsupportedWireTypeException
classes.description: Indicates that a wire type is unsupported.

classes.name: ReferenceNotFoundException
classes.description: Indicates that a referenced value was not found, includes reference ID and type.

classes.name: UnknownReferencedTypeException
classes.description: Indicates that a referenced type was not recognized, includes reference ID.

classes.name: ReferenceFieldNotSupportedException
classes.description: Indicates that a reference to a value is not supported in the current context.

classes.name: UnknownWellKnownTypeException
classes.description: Indicates that a well-known type ID is unknown.

classes.name: IllegalTypeException
classes.description: Indicates that a type is not allowed for serialization.

classes.name: TypeMissingException
classes.description: Indicates that a type was expected but not found.

classes.name: RequiredFieldMissingException
classes.description: Indicates that a required field was missing during deserialization.

classes.name: CodecNotFoundException
classes.description: Indicates that no suitable serializer codec was found for a type.

classes.name: UnexpectedLengthPrefixValueException
classes.description: Indicates that a length-prefixed field has an unexpected length value.

classes.name: ExceptionHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing utility methods, such as throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: ThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: A generic method that throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a given argument name.
